podcast.title: Peanut Allergy Incident (May 2013)
podcast.body: In May 2013, a newspaper called San published a headline stating "un cacahuete casi mata Lee Amgala Gheri" (a peanut almost kills Lee Amgala Gheri), which was deemed a surreal and hard-to-believe incident. "cuando el periodico de San en mayo de 2013 sacaba un titular que ponía un cacahuete casi mata Lee Amgala Gheri."

podcast.title: Chicago Festival Walk-Off (Early August this year)
podcast.body: During an important festival in Chicago in early August, Lee Amgala Gheri walked off stage approximately 15-20 minutes into his performance without explanation. He later claimed to have vocal problems preventing him from singing, although this explanation was not convincing to the press. "en primeros agosto de este año cuando daban concierto un muy importante festival de Chicago en el que él apenas 15-20 minutos después de empezar la actuación se larga de escenarios y en dar explicaciones luego él decía que tenía unos problemas de voz que le impedían cantarlo cual no tenía mucha pinta de que fue ese cierto."

podcast.title: Controversial Public Figure
podcast.body: Lee Amgala Gheri is described as an enormously controversial personality who often seeks headlines and creates polemic situations. This tendency frequently overshadows his other activities and makes it difficult to objectively assess his musical material alone. "Lee Amgala Gheri, enormemente polémico, que hace que al mezclar las tres cosas pues sea muy difícil ser objetivo y señirse solo a lo que es el material en sí."

podcast.title: Financial Troubles (Last 2-3 Years)
podcast.body: In the two to three years preceding his solo album, Lee Amgala Gheri experienced significant financial problems, leading him to divest a substantial portion of his assets. Initial speculation suggested his solo album was driven by economic interest to escape this situation. "los problemas financieros que estaba pasando Lee Amgala Gheri en los últimos años que habían hecho que se deshiciése de una parte importante de su patrimonio."

podcast.title: Identifying Artistic Gaps
podcast.body: Lee Amgala Gheri is credited with positively identifying his own artistic shortcomings and effectively collaborating with top artists to bolster areas where he might have been less proficient. This approach, where he surrounded himself with the best, suggests a lack of purely economic motives behind his new solo album. "Liam Gallagher yo creo que en este caso tenemos que decir positivamente que ha sabido identificar un poco sus canencias que no es una persona que sepa hacer de todo y ha sabido completarlas con los mejores artistas que podían darle soporte."

podcast.title: Manchester Terrorist Attack Fundraiser (May this year)
podcast.body: Prior to the Chicago incident, in May of the same year, Lee Amgala Gheri performed a small acoustic concert in Manchester to raise funds for the victims of a fatal terrorist attack in the city. Despite the noble cause, this event received no press coverage. "en mayo también había hecho un pequeño concierto agosto y con Manchester para recodar fondos en honor a las personas que habían sido víctimas el fatal atentado terrorista de Manchester y nadie le había hecho caso."

podcast.title: Physical and Vocal Improvement (Last Year)
podcast.body: Over the past year, Lee Amgala Gheri has undergone significant physical improvement, reducing his alcohol consumption and adopting a calmer lifestyle. This transformation has notably enhanced his voice, which has become more powerful, confident, and in-tune, reminiscent of his "golden years." This improvement has led to a reduction in sensationalist opinions about his purported financial motives for his solo work. "Lee Amgala Gheri ha cambiado mucho, ha mejorado mucho físicamente él ha disminuido mucho el consumo del col y lleve una vida mucho más tranquila, su voz ha mejorado un montón no se nos recuerda mucho a esa voz más potente, más segura y más afinada que tenía un poco en los años dorados."
